name: 02 - Perplexity Research, OpenAI Email, Instantly Send

nodes.name: Every 6 Hours
nodes.notes: Adjust cadence. 4x/day is enough for press-release + job-posting signals.

nodes.name: RSS - Funding News
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: add PR Newswire / Crunchbase News feed URLs too - chain more RSS Feed Read nodes into the same Tag node if you add more.

nodes.name: RSS - Restructuring News
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: set up a Google Alert for restructuring/layoffs/cost optimization startup and use its RSS feed URL.

nodes.name: Apify - LinkedIn Jobs Scraper (Finance Hiring)
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: set APIFY_TOKEN env var on your VPS, and swap in a real LinkedIn Jobs Scraper actor ID from Apify Store.

nodes.name: Apify - LinkedIn Company Scraper (Expansion)
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: swap in a real LinkedIn Company Scraper actor ID.

nodes.name: Apify - BuiltWith Tech Detector (ERP Signal)
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: swap in a real BuiltWith/tech-detection actor ID. Catches companies newly implementing an ERP - a strong finance-leadership-needed signal.

nodes.name: Get Existing Companies
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: set your real Airtable Base ID. Pulls every company already tracked so we don't re-process it.

nodes.name: Enrich Company (Firmographics)
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: APOLLO_API_KEY env var. Returns industry, employee count, HQ location, funding stage.

nodes.name: Matches ICP?
nodes.notes: Add headcount / funding-stage thresholds once you confirm what Apollo returns for your test batch.

nodes.name: Find Decision-Maker Contact
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: HUNTER_API_KEY env var. Filter results for titles matching your ICP decision-maker list.

nodes.name: Verify Email
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: MILLIONVERIFIER_API_KEY env var.

nodes.name: Create Qualified Lead Record
nodes.notes: This row is what Workflow 2 (AI Research + Send) picks up next. Status field is the handoff mechanism between all 5 workflows.

nodes.name: Process One Company At A Time
nodes.notes: Deliberately serial (batchSize:1) so you stay inside Claude/Instantly rate limits and can watch cost per run in the executions log.

nodes.name: Claude - Company Research
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY env var. Uses claude-sonnet-5 with the web_search tool so research is grounded, not hallucinated.

assignments.name: company_name
assignments.value: ={{$('Process One Company At A Time').item.json.fields['Company Name']}}

assignments.name: decision_maker_name
assignments.value: ={{$('Process One Company At A Time').item.json.fields['Decision Maker Name']}}

assignments.name: decision_maker_title
assignments.value: ={{$('Process One Company At A Time').item.json.fields['Decision Maker Title']}}

assignments.name: decision_maker_email
assignments.value: ={{$('Process One Company At A Time').item.json.fields['Decision Maker Email']}}

nodes.name: Carry Lead Context Forward
nodes.notes: n8n Set node - keeps company/contact fields alongside the research text so the email-generation node has everything it needs in one place.

nodes.name: Claude - Generate Email 1
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: set env vars CLIENT_NAME, CLIENT_YEARS_EXPERIENCE, CLIENT_BIO_SUMMARY on your VPS - this is the 'trained on 20 years experience' step from the spec, done via system prompt rather than fine-tuning.

nodes.name: Instantly - Add Lead & Launch Email 1
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: INSTANTLY_API_KEY, INSTANTLY_CAMPAIGN_ID env vars. Adding a lead to an active campaign auto-enrolls them in the sequence; the 'personalization' field is what your Email 1 template should reference as {{personalization}} inside Instantly's campaign editor so the AI-written body actually gets sent.

nodes.name: Update Lead Status
nodes.notes: This status flip is what Workflow 3 watches for to start the no-reply/follow-up clock.

nodes.name: Apify - Jobs Scraper (Hiring Signal)
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: APIFY_TOKEN env var. Actor slug verified live: powerai/linkedin-jobs-scraper.

nodes.name: Apify - Company Scraper (Expansion Signal)
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: verify 'queries'/'type'/'limit' field names against this actor's current input schema in Apify Console before first run - Store actor schemas change between versions.

nodes.name: Apify - Tech Detector (ERP Signal)
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: verify input schema in Apify Console (builtwith-scraper).

nodes.name: Read Existing Leads Sheet
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: your real Google Sheet ID. Sheet must have a tab literally named 'Leads' with header row: Company Name, Domain, Signal Types, Priority, Decision Maker Name, Decision Maker Title, Decision Maker Email, Email Status, Status, Created Date, Last Touch Date, Email 1 Body.

parameters.jsonBody:
={

  "page": 1
}

nodes.name: Apollo - People Search (Find Decision-Maker)
nodes.notes: Uses /mixed_people/api_search (NOT /mixed_people/search, which 403s on Basic plan). Does not consume credits - returns candidates without email.

nodes.name: Any Candidates Found?
nodes.notes: Guard node - without this, a company with zero Apollo matches would break the batch loop (empty output halts downstream execution for that iteration).

nodes.name: Apollo - Reveal Email (1 credit)
nodes.notes: This is the only credit-consuming call in the pipeline - 1 credit per email revealed. Basic plan (~900 credits/yr) covers ~75/month.

value.Priority: ={{$('Process One Company At A Time1').item.json.signal_count >= 3 ? 'Top' : ($('Process One Company At A Time1').item.json.signal_count >= 2 ? 'High' : 'Low')}}

nodes.name: Wait (Rate Limit Buffer)
nodes.notes: Small pause before next loop iteration - keeps Apollo/Apify calls from bursting.

nodes.name: RSS - Funding News1
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: add PR Newswire / Crunchbase News feeds too, chained into the same Tag node.

nodes.name: RSS - Restructuring News1
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: Google Alert RSS feed for restructuring/layoffs/cost-optimization + startup.

nodes.name: Tag Expansion Signals1
nodes.notes: Also captures firmographics from the company actor - reused later so we don't need a separate Apollo org-enrichment call.

nodes.name: Matches ICP?1
nodes.notes: Runs on firmographics already captured from the Apify company actor. Companies from funding/hiring/erp-only signals with no firmographics yet will fail this - add a fallback Apify company lookup for those if you see too many false negatives in testing.

nodes.name: Process One Company At A Time1
nodes.notes: Serial processing - deliberate, to respect Apollo rate limits and avoid burning credits on a bad run.

nodes.name: Filter Status = ready_for_outreach
nodes.notes: n8n's Google Sheets node returns a 'row_number' field automatically - used later to update the exact row.

nodes.name: Process One Lead At A Time
nodes.notes: Serial - respects Perplexity/OpenAI/Instantly rate limits and keeps per-run cost visible in the execution log.

nodes.name: Perplexity - Company Research
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: PERPLEXITY_API_KEY env var. sonar-pro with search_context_size:low keeps the per-request search fee at the cheap end of Perplexity's published range.

nodes.name: OpenAI - Generate Email 1
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: OPENAI_API_KEY, CLIENT_NAME, CLIENT_YEARS_EXPERIENCE, CLIENT_BIO_SUMMARY env vars. gpt-5.4-mini is intentionally the cheap tier - short-form email copy doesn't need flagship reasoning.

nodes.name: Update Row Status
nodes.notes: This status flip is the handoff point for the follow-up/reply workflow.

parameters.jsCode:
const research = items[0].json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '';
return [{ json: { research } }];

const emailBody = (items[0].json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content || '').trim();
return [{ json: { ...items[0].json, email_1_body: emailBody } }];

nodes.name: Instantly - Add Lead & Launch Email
nodes.notes: CONFIGURE: INSTANTLY_API_KEY, INSTANTLY_CAMPAIGN_ID env vars. Your Instantly campaign's Email 1 template body must literally be {{personalization}} for the AI draft to actually go out.
